alt: Graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane on a gridded coordinate plane, x and y axes each from -8 to 8. The curve has two separate branches: one rising from left to right in the upper left region and a second branch in the lower right region.

Graph in the xy-plane of estimated population y, in thousands, against x, years since 2007. The horizontal axis is marked from 1 to 5 and the vertical axis from 2 to 12; a single curve rises from left to right, increasingly steeply.

Graph in the xy-plane of a town's population y, in thousands, against x, years since 2003. The horizontal axis is marked from 2 to 14 and the vertical axis from 2 to 10; a single curve rises from left to right, growing steeper as x increases.

Graph in the xy-plane of momentum y, in newton-seconds, against time x, in seconds, on a grid with x marked from 1 to 9 and y from 1 to 10. A smooth increasing curve is drawn through five marked points.

The complete graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane, on a grid with the x-axis marked from 2 to 12 and the y-axis from -8 to 8. A single increasing curve rises from the lower part of the grid, flattens briefly, then climbs steeply.
